name: DeepSearcher
description: Deep-research agent over private data stored in a vector database, producing reasoned answers and reports.
whatItDoes: Loads local files or web pages into a vector store and then searches, evaluates and reasons over them to answer questions or write reports. It is aimed at enterprise knowledge management and internal Q&A.
howItWorks: Documents are chunked, embedded and stored in Milvus or Zilliz Cloud. At query time the agent decomposes the question, retrieves across collections, reflects on gaps and iterates before composing a report; online content can be mixed in when needed. It offers a CLI, a Python API and a service started with main.py.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Default LLM provider; many alternatives are supported

run: deepsearcher query "Write a report about xxx."
models: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, Ollama and other providers
